# dist

`m5-routeb-kit-2026-10-22-v2.zip` — portable Route B kit for the
`toolchain-v4-ready` VM: probe/verify/comparators, Ghidra export, normalized C,
fixture ELF + manifests + six-entry contract.

SHA-256 is in `m5-routeb-kit-2026-10-22-v2.zip.sha256`. Canonical files are under
`routeb/` and `fixtures/` in this repository.
